Clarity behind the counter

A clear sales workflow for your whole team.

Deli products, fresh fish, prepared meals or a customer order: your range calls for a recognisable product layout and practical operation. Match your till to individual products, sales by weight and how staff serve customers.

From an affordable starter till to a comprehensive professional setup: KassaKompas considers the equipment and POS software you need today and the extensions that suit your plans.

Weighing and recording

A weighing solution suited to your products.

Connected scales can support the handling of weighed products. We check how product selection, weight and price work together in the proposed configuration and which requirements apply.

  • Find products easily
    A clear layout for meat, fish, deli products, prepared meals and other product groups.
  • Combine items sold individually and by weight
    Test different sales methods with your own range.
  • Suitable equipment at your counter
    Discuss scales, screens and printers based on available space and responsibilities.

Shop scales and the POS system must be assessed as a specific combination. We confirm the possibilities before you decide.

From order to payment

A logical workflow during busy periods.

An order often includes several products chosen one after another. Review how staff add items, handle changes and complete the sale. A demonstration using your own situations makes operation tangible.

Staff and access permissions

Discuss how your team signs in and which actions each person may perform, such as changing prices, making corrections and viewing reports. Available sign-in methods and permissions depend on the solution.

Printers and workstations

Want to use several printers or sales points? We review where information is needed and how receipts and sales are handled in your workflow.

A clear payment step

Match cash and electronic payments to your business. A suitable integration can reduce manual amount entry; we check the payment provider, devices and software versions.

Saving, taking over and completing a sale also deserve attention when several staff members work at the counter. Test these steps with your team in advance.

Information for your customer

A customer display as part of your service.

A suitable customer display can show the recorded sale. Depending on the display and POS software, your own images or promotional messages may also be shown.

We discuss screen size, positioning and the information you want to show. Choose a setup that customers can read and staff can use comfortably.

Match your screen layout to your range

A logical layout helps your team find products. Discuss useful groups and shortcuts and how you manage product and price changes.

Back office and administration

Keep track of sales and workstations.

Which sales reports do you need and who may view them? We examine available reporting and management features, including any remote access and management across several locations.

Invoicing and accounting

We review your invoicing and whether sales data can be transferred to your accounting package. We agree in advance which data the specific systems will exchange.

Catering and on-site consumption

A fiscal setup suited to your activities.

A butcher’s or fish shop may offer prepared meals, catering or on-site service alongside shop sales. Any obligation to use a registered cash register system requires an assessment of your activities and circumstances.

Ask your accountant to assess the fiscal setup. If GKS is required, we separately check the necessary certification of the proposed POS software and fiscal equipment.

Practical answers

Frequently asked questions from butchers and fishmongers.

Which till suits my butcher’s or fish shop?

Consider your range, sales by weight, number of staff and the orders you handle. KassaKompas helps you weigh up an affordable starter till and a comprehensive professional setup. Test operation with products from your own counter.

Can I connect shop scales?

We assess this for the specific scales, POS software and intended handling of weighed products. We also discuss the requirements for the intended use. Scales are not automatically part of every package.

Can several staff members use the same till?

We review how staff sign in and which permissions they need. Depending on the solution, identification may use a code, key or badge. Taking over and completing sales should also be tested in advance.

Can a customer display show products and promotions?

The possibilities depend on the display and POS software. We check which sales information can be shown and whether your own images or promotions can be displayed, taking account of your space and intended use.

Can I integrate invoicing and accounting?

We check your invoicing process, accounting package and POS software, then agree which data can be exchanged and how it will be transferred. Not every integration is available as standard.

Do I need a white cash register as a butcher, fishmonger or caterer?

This depends on your activities and the applicable GKS rules. Shop sales, prepared meals and restaurant or catering services require an assessment of your specific situation. Ask your accountant to apply the official Belgian guidance to your business.

Can I manage several workstations or locations?

We discuss which product data, prices and reports you want to manage centrally. We then check how the solution exchanges information between tills or locations and which modules or connections are needed.

What does a till for a butcher’s or fish shop cost?

Costs depend on workstations, scales, displays, printers, software modules and guidance. Request a proposal with clear one-off and recurring costs and arrangements for installation and support.
